protocol.replicateCountMeaning: Fixed engineering Monte Carlo budget; not a statistical acceptance threshold or sufficient-tail-sample claim
protocol.observationWeight: -log(uniform), one positive exponential likelihood multiplier per original match
protocol.sharedDraws: FT and HT use the same original-event likelihood multipliers; HT exclusions remain in its original input denominator
protocol.replicateWeights: 1 / replicatesPerLeague; algorithmic Monte Carlo weights, not source-observed scenario probabilities
protocol.failurePolicy: Retain every attempted replicate and its reason; never replace, select favorable fits, or renormalize surviving replicate weights
protocol.fitPolicy: Preserve the existing frozen baseline cutoff, selected half-life, penalty, dependence grid, original rows and training hashes; use the existing optimizer with maxIterations 6000 and tolerance 0.000001
protocol.halfTimeFitPolicy: Preserve the existing frozen HT cutoff and selected half-life; conditional binomial exposure fit uses the same per-match likelihood multipliers as FT
protocol.sourcePolicy: Read only the committed normalized FT and enriched HT gzip histories; verify original IDs, scores, timestamps and source receipts, and preserve original source hashes
protocol.historicalAvailability: Historical scores and HT observations were backfilled at their original collection times; missing source publication times remain unknown
protocol.diagnosticPolicy: The reused 2025 development diagnostic is not a new untouched OOS test; no model selection, calibration improvement or betting-return claim is made here
protocol.interpretation: Parameter-sensitivity research under an explicit independent-match exponential likelihood-reweighting assumption; not an empirical model-error margin, confidence interval, scenario-probability estimate or formal R

limitations: Exponential likelihood reweighting assumes independent matches; schedule/team dependence and model misspecification are not covered
Sixteen equally weighted replicates are a disclosed engineering approximation, not observed scenario probabilities or a verified q10 tail estimate
Original history was backfilled; missing source publication timestamps remain unknown
Fixed baseline cutoff and hyperparameters are reused; default baseline coefficients are unchanged
The reused 2025 development diagnostic is not a new untouched OOS test
No empirical net-return model-error artifact, calibration acceptance, settlement approval, confidence coverage or formal R follows from these scenarios
